information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTE1NzE3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--217a24da4eae50b86bad3e8edb668a7f5f61e8ee/91baeb65-94ac-4934-a044-41b138750f82.jpg) In cooperation with **MNMCS**, **CSJDM cubers**, and **RPM cubers**, we are pleased to announce the **QC Speedcubing Open 2025**, which will take place at Robinsons Magnolia on August 31, 2025. The competition features the following events: 2x2, 4x4, 3x3 BLD, Pyraminx, Clock, Skewb, and finally, the competition's main event, 3x3.
